lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible across the mid-body. Posterior to the pectoral fin, the spots are arranged in roughly vertical columns of 3 to 5 units, forming a staggered hexagonal-like distribution in some areas.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Pale vertical bands intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance spots, forming a grid-like pattern across the lateral flank, most prominently between the second and third longitudinal ridges.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges run parallel to the longitudinal axis along the upper half of the visible flank, characterized by a high-intensity light reflection on the dorsal edge and a shadow gradient on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a distribution of small, high-luminance spots across its visible silhouette, with a noticeably higher concentration of smaller spots towards the distal edges compared to the fin base.

other_distinctive_markers: An elongated, low-luminance feature is visible in the ventral region below the mid-flank, consistent with a commensal organism or hitchhiker.
